feedback.problem:
Which of the following equalities are true given that
$D={(x,y)\,:\,0\le x\le \sqrt{2},\,-\sqrt{3}\le y\le 2}.$

- ${∬}_{D}\sqrt{1+{x}^{2}{y}^{2}}\,\text{d}A={\int }_{0}^{\sqrt{2}}{\int }_{-\sqrt{3}}^{2}\sqrt{1+{x}^{2}{y}^{2}}\,\text{d}y\,\text{d}x$
- ${∬}_{D}\sqrt{1+{x}^{2}{y}^{2}}\,\text{d}A={\int }_{-\sqrt{3}}^{2}{\int }_{0}^{\sqrt{2}}\sqrt{1+{x}^{2}{y}^{2}}\,\text{d}x\,\text{d}y$
- ${∬}_{D}\sqrt{1+{x}^{2}{y}^{2}}\,\text{d}A={\int }_{-\sqrt{3}}^{2}{\int }_{0}^{\sqrt{2}}\sqrt{1+{x}^{2}{y}^{2}}\,\text{d}y\,\text{d}x$
feedback.worked_solution:
We notice that:  

- the limits for the variable $x$ are from $0$ to $\sqrt{2}$, and

- the limits for the variable $y$ are from $-\sqrt{3}$ to $2.$

Therefore,

$$
\begin{aligned}{∬}_{D}\sqrt{1+{x}^{2}{y}^{2}}\,\text{d}A & ={\int }_{-\sqrt{3}}^{2}[{\int }_{0}^{\sqrt{2}}\sqrt{1+{x}^{2}{y}^{2}}\,\text{d}x]\text{d}y.\end{aligned}
$$

Now, since the region of integration is rectangular, we can simply swap the order of integration. This gives

$$
{∬}_{D}\sqrt{1+{x}^{2}{y}^{2}}\,\text{d}A={\int }_{0}^{\sqrt{2}}[{\int }_{-\sqrt{3}}^{2}\sqrt{1+{x}^{2}{y}^{2}}\,\text{d}y]\text{d}x.
$$

So, the correct answer is "I and II only".
